concerns.text: The plan never validates the raw eBird CSV (`ebd_subset.csv`) against the `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` contract, even though that contract exists and is intended for the raw checklist schema. This leaves the `dataset.schema.yaml` contract unexercised, violating the plan‑consistency requirement that every contract be exercised by at least one plan element.

The `grid_cell_observation.schema.yaml` contract requires a `threshold_used` field, but the plan’s description of T015 does not mention writing this column to `first_arrival_sweep.csv`. Without explicitly recording which cumulative‑count threshold (3, 5, 10) produced the `first_arrival_week`, the output will fail schema validation.
